task.instruction: Synthesize migration evidence for a collaborative document format with uncertain extension compatibility.
task.deliverable: A migration synthesis, invariant recovery path, and supporting evidence.

evidence.content: A synthetic audit finds 16 extensions: 12 compatible, 3 need small adapters, and 1 has unowned binary output.
A synthetic conversion-safety rule requires an exportable pre-conversion snapshot for every migration, so recovery remains possible even when collaboration locks favor a one-way conversion.
Parallel read mode rolls back in 11 minutes; a one-way conversion simplifies collaboration locks but requires a coordinated freeze.

A.content: When uncertainty remains, favor a choice that can be revised after new evidence without disproportionate cost.

B.content: When coordination depends on certainty, favor a clear commitment with the resources needed to carry it through.

irrelevant.content: Place the concise summary before the supporting detail.

decisions.prompt: Which migration conclusion should the synthesis support?
regionOptions: commit to one-way conversion during a coordinated freeze
keep parallel read mode until the unowned extension is resolved

T0: keep parallel read mode until the unowned extension is resolved
commit to one-way conversion during a coordinated freeze
T1-A: keep parallel read mode until the unowned extension is resolved
T1-B: commit to one-way conversion during a coordinated freeze

regionOptions: delete pre-conversion snapshots after migration starts

nonGoal: Do not remove the pre-conversion snapshot.
